name: DefTrack DeFCoN Explorer
description: Live blockchain explorer for the DeFCoN (DFCN) network. Look up addresses, transactions, blocks and masternode status.

endpoints.name: lookup
endpoints.description: Auto-detect and look up a DeFCoN address, transaction hash, block hash, or block height in one call.

params.name: q
params.description: A DeFCoN address (starts with D), a 64-char hex hash (tx or block), or a block height integer.

endpoints.name: network
endpoints.description: Current network status: latest block height and masternode summary.

endpoints.name: masternode
endpoints.description: Look up a masternode by IP, IP:port or proTxHash.

params.name: q
params.description: IP, IP:port (e.g. 203.0.113.10:8192) or proTxHash. A bare IP matches the masternode registered on that IP.

rules: Always fetch live data from the API; do not hallucinate balances or transaction details.
DeFCoN addresses start with the letter D and are 26-34 characters long.
64-character hex strings are automatically detected as either tx hash or block hash.
All amount fields (balance, totalReceived, totalSent, reward, totalIn, totalOut, fee) are integer strings in satoshis (e.g. '1050000000000' = 10,500 DFCN). Divide by 100000000 for DFCN.
Each successful response includes data.explorerUrl, a link to the human-readable explorer page.
Errors return success: false with an error or hint field and HTTP status 400, 404 or 500. HTTP 429 means the per-IP rate limit was reached.
